description: Queue a restart of the Mac (needs the manage scope; owners only). The Mac reboots about a minute after the agent picks the job up; 10-minute cooldown; refused while FileVault is on. Returns an action; poll get_action or machine_status to see it come back.

machine.description: Machine id (UUID) or name, e.g. mini-02-585

wait.description: Wait (up to 10 minutes) until the Mac is back online

name: restart_machine
title: Restart machine
